reference_voltage.note: FOR_rolling<ref>.csv VmaxTrue (pu, AC check of each directional solve); max over the 12 directions per step

R1.definition: BESS level, fleet sums of FOR_rolling_crit (3 aggregator rows). shortfall(180°) = ΣD_s + Σ ΔP^b_s at θ = 180°; gap(0°) = ΣU_s − Σ ΔP^b_s at θ = 0°

R6.definition: share180 = −Σ ΔP^b / ΣD_s at θ = 180°; share0 = Σ ΔP^b / ΣU_s at θ = 0° (per aggregator, BESS level). For network-wide runs the crit file has one group 'ALL'; per-aggregator values come from FOR_rolling_fair sumP_pu minus the reference's per-aggregator baseline.
